description.narrative: Based in Antigua and Barbuda but operating regionally, Intersect is a youth-led organization committed to gender justice and to centering the experiences and needs of those most marginalized, including queer, trans, and non-binary people and those with disabilities who are Black, Indigenous, and identify as people of colour. Their work is centered on digital activism, building feminist coalitions, and investing in decentering the aemy by co-creating Queeribbean feminist thought with people across communities. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries and stipends, bank fees, fiscal sponsor fees, and financial management-related costs.
